stem: A pH probe remains unstable after permitted verification. What is the best data-quality response?
choices: Use the average of unstable values as verified
Treat the reading as suspect and escalate the instrument issue
Change solution until the meter looks stable
rationale: Treat the reading as suspect and escalate the instrument issue. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
